authorship_disclosure.review_independence_boundary: Independent review of the root-run guardian receipts and descriptive gain module; not an independent author review of cases.py or its fixture design.

review_method: Read-only code, receipt, artifact and small-file SHA256 inspection; no tests, workers, model imports, native execution or checkpoint reads by reviewer.

cpu_guardian_review.hardware_lease: Atomic Win32 CreateFileW with read/write access and share mode zero; child duplicates the owned handle, verifies canonical path and observes sharing violation for a competing open.
cpu_guardian_review.containment: Suspended launcher assigned to a Job before payload execution; actual CPython PID/create-time/ancestry and Job membership are checked before pinned package imports.
cpu_guardian_review.source_execution: Isolated -I -B -S startup and compilation of admitted package source bytes; stale package pyc and model/native module imports are blocked.
cpu_guardian_review.limits: One CPU affinity, 512 MiB Job private commit and process-tree RSS ceilings, measured RAM reserve, bounded output and wall watchdog.

verified_input_patterns.regular_supported_numeric_gold: 250 positive and zero negative without replay; 200 positive and zero negative with replay.
verified_input_patterns.hard_supported_numeric_gold: 125 positive/125 negative without replay; 100 positive/100 negative with replay.
verified_input_patterns.hard_diverse_ledger: Canonical/native_b carry positive operands; native_a/natural carry negative operands, exactly 125 rows per style or 100 with replay.
verified_input_patterns.conditional_style_branch: Both diverse difficulty arms map canonical/native_b to true and native_a/natural to false.
verified_input_patterns.conditional_margins: Only zero and one; 124 rows at each margin without replay and 100 at each margin with replay.
verified_input_patterns.held_prompt_factor: Semantic/evidence/world membership matches, while answerability supervised abstention strings change under the natural contract.
verified_input_patterns.difficulty_factor: Fresh parent worlds differ and counterfactual rows share paired parents; not an isolated hardness effect.
verified_input_patterns.seeds: All eight seed comparisons preserve training membership and change row order; this is not independent data replication.
verified_input_patterns.unadopted_maps: All four maps preserve semantic membership, exact family/style totals and observed-case floor/ceil quotas; targets were not re-rendered and no tokenizer/model qualification occurred.

retained_review_history.finding: Supported answerable rows could previously be marked both abstained and semantically correct in descriptive scored summaries.
retained_review_history.resolution: Root changed only gain_attribution.py and its test to reject that contradiction, archived original sibling bytes, and produced current-source fixtures-002/cases-002 receipts.
retained_review_history.historical_fixture_proof: fixtures-001 passed 47 tests; current fixtures-002 passed 48.
retained_review_history.current_gain_effect: None: the current gain report remains unmeasured with zero scored trials.

prospective_decision_note.cue_status_shortcut: The complete-notes phrase appears only in unsupported missing/conflict cases, while the may-be-incomplete phrase appears only in supported cases. Counterfactual construction retains this inverse mapping.
prospective_decision_note.why_style_assignment_is_insufficient: Redistributing scenarios among styles leaves literal cue/status dependence intact, and evaluation uses the same constructor mapping.
prospective_decision_note.alternative: Prospectively counterbalance complete/incomplete/neutral cue wording over identical facts and semantic golds, across support classes and styles, under a separately reviewed data decision.
prospective_decision_note.caveat: Missing rows do not render their latent negative quantity; conflict scalar facts do render negative values. Grounded-QA dock labels use absolute values.

limitations: Input construction patterns and CPU fixtures are not Rineya capability evidence.
Descriptive DEV summaries are untrusted inputs and cannot authenticate a native gain or justify promotion.
Whole-sweep cost feasibility, native memory/optimizer behavior and source-bound native observations remain unqualified.
The reviewer's authorship of cases.py/test_cases.py limits independence for that subsystem.
